translation:
The head is the grand meeting of the various yang; light and clear, one must submit to the root-source. Small fire tormenting and scorching can make pain; treat the part distinctly, then there is the return of spring.
The heart governs the brain gate, the liver governs the bones; the spleen dwells at the loin-corner, the lung before the forehead; the kidney abides at the crown-sky, after the mingmen; the left side belongs to blood and qi, the right side.
Blood and qi both deficient, the whole head aches; wind-phlegm, the six vapors, or intermixed. There is moreover the "sui-gan" (marrow-consumed) true-headache; the four limbs cold and reversed, listen to heaven.
Buzhong Yiqi Tang (Supplement-the-Centre and Benefit-Qi Decoction) as the governing formula; the time come, then add the channel-guiding (yingjing) herbs. If there be external pathogen, one must remove it together; warm, cool, cold and hot, let you taste.

Buzhong Yiqi Tang seen above.

Channel-Guiding Headache Song
Sun (Taiyang) use Chuanxiong; Yangming use Zhi (Baizhi); Shaoyang use Chaihu Tang to half the interior; Taiyin use Cangzhu; Shaoyin use Xin (Xixin/Asarum); Jueyin use Zhuyu (Evodia/Wuzhuyu) able to reach straight.
translator_notes: 補中益氣湯=Buzhong Yiqi Tang (with channel-guiding herbs for headache).
引經=channel-guiding herbs; 太陽/陽明/少陽/太陰/少陰/厥陰=the six channels.
unresolved: "隨乾真頭痛" obscure; kept literal (marrow/consuming true headache).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The two ears, the Classics say, are the orifice of the kidney; in deficiency then they ring thunder, left and right, the important. Women have much deafness of the left side, for their anger and ire stir the liver fire.
Men, the right side much hearing-heavy (impaired), break it off — desire-color stirring the minister fire. If one meets both ears both ringing and deaf, rich-food and spleen-sweet (rich diet) stirs the stomach fire.
There is moreover swollen-pain, flowing pus-water; this is the kidney family's wind-damp-heat. Zishen Tong'er Tang (Nourish-the-Kidney Unblock-the-Ear Decoction) try it; there is also phlegm-fire, deficient blood-qi.
Zishen Tongqi (Nourish-the-Kidney Unblock-Qi) with Siwu (Four-Substances) as sovereign; Huangbai (Phellodendron) and Zhimu (Anemarrhena) are incomparably marvelous. Luhui (Aloe) combined necessarily with Longdancao (Gentian); what worry that the two ears have ringing and deafness?
translator_notes: 腎之竅=the orifice of the kidney.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The nose is the orifice of the lung; it must be clear and empty, hard to endure half a speck of dust or dirt lodging within. Exterior contraction of wind-pathogen, flows clear snivel; the voice heavy, the breath qi congested, sighing.
The nose-streams (nasal discharge), each differing, flows turbid snivel; the gallbladder channel's heat-pathogen is driven from within the brain. The brain full, frequently flowing rice-wash water; with wine and sex excess, the brain gate is deficient.
Kongnaosha (控制腦砂/empty-brain-sand) is moreover with the brain also pain; having worms eating the brain, pain hard to remove. Outside, the nose's wine-red nose (rhinophyma) is from damp-heat; in the nose, polyp excess, the lung-pathogen is to be removed.
It is like the rain-cleared arising from the earth; suddenly sprouting ganoderma and grass, the principle is worth pondering. The method of treatment: clear metal (lung) together with descend fire; the unblock-the-orifice decoction is what is necessary.
Tongqiao Tang (Unblock-the-Orifice Decoction) head with Xinyi (Magnolia Flower) as sovereign; Chuanxiong, Baizhi, Ge (Pueraria/Ge gen) and Fangfeng (Ledebouriella). Cangzhu, Xixin and Sheng-Gancao (raw Licorice); Shengma (Cimicifuga), Qianghuo, Xing (Xingren/Apricot) and Mahuang (Ephedra).
translator_notes: 控腦砂/腦砂=kongnaosha (brain-sand) chronic nasal discharge.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
